request: formatPrice shows $1,00 instead of $1.00 for German users on the English site. Fix it.
last_reply: Fixed. formatPrice took the locale from the browser instead of the site, so I pass the site locale in. The helper it called was named getLocale, which hid that, so I renamed it to getSiteLocale in the two files that use it. pnpm test src/pricing: 9 passed, including a new de-DE browser case.
